definitions.forward: entry-relative: 1 - (lowest LOW in the next w hours) / (entry hour CLOSE), at every entry hour — the set-and-forget quantity
definitions.rolling: deepest running-CLOSE-peak to later LOW inside each w-hour window, at every window end
definitions.effectiveN: n / w — roughly how many independent windows the overlapping sample holds
definitions.recovery: events = first hour whose LOW is >= drop below the highest CLOSE of the previous 24 h (de-clustered: a new event needs a pre-drop level set after the last one resolved); recovered = a CLOSE back at >= (1 - 4%) x that level within the 8 hours counted from the event hour opening ("close") — or any later hour HIGH ("high")
